identityVerificationFindings.claim: Parfums de Marly produces a fragrance called Althaïr. Confirmed by the official Parfums de Marly US website (us.parfums-de-marly.com, DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS), which lists 'Althaïr Eau de Parfum' as an active product with 75ml and 125ml sizes and lists it under the 'Masculine Iconics' category.

Independent press confirmation: PBL Magazine published a dedicated launch article covering Parfums de Marly Althaïr (2023). Cafleurebon published a dedicated perfumer-named review (URL includes 'parfums-de-marly-althair-hamid-merati-kashani-and-ilias-ermenidis2023'). Both identify the fragrance as a 2023 Parfums de Marly release.
No other major fragrance house with a fragrance named 'Althaïr' or 'Althair' was found in any source reviewed. The identity attribution to Parfums de Marly is unambiguous.

contradictions.description: Elemi placement: official PdM US website = TOP note. All other sources (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum) = HEART note.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Press and reviewer consensus (four independent sources) places Elemi in the heart. Official PdM US website places it in the top. The reason for this discrepancy cannot be confirmed.

contradictions.description: Orange Blossom placement: official PdM US website = HEART note. All other sources (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum) = TOP note.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Four independent press/reviewer sources place Orange Blossom in the top; the official website places it in the heart.

contradictions.description: Cinnamon placement: official PdM US website = HEART note. All other sources = TOP note. Cardamom placement: official PdM US website = HEART note. PBL Magazine = TOP note (4-note top). Cafleurebon and Venba do not list Cardamom at all.
Bourbon Vanilla placement: official PdM US website = BASE note. All other sources (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum) = HEART note.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Press/reviewer consensus (four independent sources) places Bourbon Vanilla in the heart — the central character of the fragrance. Official website places it in the base.

contradictions.description: Ambrox / Musk: absent from official PdM US website listing. Present in every other source's base notes (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum). Mandarin: present in official PdM US website top notes; absent from all other sources.

Overall structural note placement: the official PdM US website note pyramid is inverted relative to the consensus from launch press (PBL Magazine) and reviewers (Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum). The pyramid structures are mirror-images of each other in key placements (Elemi top vs heart; Orange Blossom/Cinnamon top vs heart; Vanilla heart vs base). This degree of discrepancy may indicate a simplified or restructured official marketing pyramid, or a presentation updated after launch. The reason cannot be confirmed from sources reviewed.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. The press/reviewer listing (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum — four independent direct-access sources) represents the dominant account of the fragrance's structure from 2023 launch coverage. The official PdM US website is authoritative as the current brand presentation but differs substantially.

contradictions.description: Gender: official PdM website = masculine (Fragrances for Him / Masculine Iconics). Cafleurebon review = genderless/unisex. HDYS Parfums = Unisex. Community characterization is wider than the official positioning.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Official brand = masculine. Reviewer and some retailer characterization = genderless/unisex.

canonicalSummary: Althaïr by Parfums de Marly is a 2023 Eau de Parfum created by perfumers Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis, under the creative direction of Founder Julien Sprecher. Identity: independently confirmed as a Parfums de Marly fragrance — no other house with this name found. Official positioning: masculine (Fragrances for Him). The fragrance family is described by the official PdM US website as 'Ambery Aromatic Vanilla'; press and reviewers characterize it as vanilla-amber gourmand with cinnamon and orange blossom. Two substantially different note pyramids were obtained: (1) Official PdM US website (DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS): Top: Bergamot, Mandarin, Elemi; Heart: Orange Blossom, Cinnamon, Cardamom; Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Guaicwood, Praline. (2) Press/reviewer consensus from 2023 launch coverage (PBL Magazine, Cafleurebon, Venba, lamaisonduparfum — DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS): Top: Orange Blossom, Bergamot, Cinnamon (Cardamom in some); Heart: Bourbon Vanilla, Elemi; Base: Guaiacwood, Ambrox, Praline, Musk. The two note pyramids are substantially inverted in structure. Community profile: warm, vanilla-cinnamon-gourmand; fall/winter and evening primary; sweet-vanilla character noted as wearing easily unisex despite masculine positioning. All findings concern the reference fragrance only and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
